title: Run agent (prompt)
text: The Vue component trims the prompt and blocks duplicate or invalid submissions.
explanation: refs store request state; computed values derive validity and safe presentation. The API repeats validation independently.

title: POST /api/agent/stream
text: The browser posts a JSON prompt and consumes the same-origin response stream.
explanation: Vite preserves the browser Host when forwarding /api during development. Production serves Vue and the API from the same FastAPI server.

title: Validate; tools disabled
text: The service disables built-in tools and isolates settings, skills and MCP.
code:
return ClaudeAgentOptions(
    tools=[], allowed_tools=[], permission_mode='dontAsk',
    setting_sources=[], skills=[], mcp_servers={}, strict_mcp_config=True,
    max_turns=self.settings.agent_max_turns,
    model=self.settings.claude_model or None,
    system_prompt=self.settings.agent_system_prompt or None,
    env={'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY': self.settings.anthropic_api_key.get_secret_value().strip(),
         'ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS': 'false'},
)
explanation: tools=[] is the tool ban; allowed_tools=[] only controls automatic approvals. The endpoint separately validates the bounded JSON body and trimmed prompt.

title: query() / async for
text: The recognizable query() → async for → ResultMessage loop remains on the server.
explanation: This selected run_agent excerpt returns the final answer. The streaming function consumes the same SDK boundary and projects each intermediate message. aclosing releases the iterator on return, error or cancellation.

title: Prompt; no built-in tools
text: The SDK receives private model, system-prompt and authentication configuration.
code:
model=self.settings.claude_model or None,
    system_prompt=self.settings.agent_system_prompt or None,
    env={'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY': self.settings.anthropic_api_key.get_secret_value().strip(),
         'ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS': 'false'},
)
explanation: This options excerpt represents the SDK/provider boundary. The SDK owns the CLI runtime and model transport; the application does not invent a second HTTP call to Claude.

title: Model response
text: The SDK yields message objects while managing inference and lifecycle events.
explanation: The model-to-SDK arrow is observed through this iterator. Messages may arrive at different points in inference; they are not token-level deltas.

title: Safe SDK message
text: Only explicit public fields are forwarded to the API.
explanation: The branches above this yield allowlist text, system subtype and final metrics. Thinking, raw SDK objects, paths, environment and tool arguments are excluded.

title: SSE message event
text: Native FastAPI SSE encodes each projected message and then the terminal event.
code:
async with aclosing(agent.stream_agent(body.prompt)) as messages:
            async for message in messages:
                yield ServerSentEvent(event='message', data=message)
        yield ServerSentEvent(event='done', data={'status': 'complete'})
except Exception:
explanation: Yield ServerSentEvent objects directly. The framework owns framing, flushing, heartbeat and disconnect handling; do not double-encode its JSON data.

title: Update typed state
text: Each parsed message appends a timestamped timeline entry to Vue state.
explanation: The UI caps visible rows at 500 while continuing to process the final result. Vue renders the inspector from reactive state rather than manual DOM writes.

title: ResultMessage fields
text: Normalize the SDK final answer, turns, duration, estimated cost and error flag.
explanation: A non-success subtype remains an error even if is_error was false. Exact credential occurrences are redacted, and an absent cost stays null rather than being invented.

title: SSE ResultMessage
text: Runtime-check the public message and final result before dispatching to Vue.
explanation: The final ResultMessage travels in the same message event as progress. The component independently validates the final fields before updating the answer.

title: Render answer + metrics
text: Markdown fenced code uses language-aware highlighting and all output is sanitized.
explanation: Only the sanitized computed answer reaches Vue v-html. Highlighting escapes source before DOMPurify sanitizes the generated token markup.

title: SSE done event
text: Require both final result and terminal done before resolving the stream.
explanation: The final result is authoritative for success. Transport completion does not override is_error, and an early disconnect stays a failure.

title: SSE error; no done
text: Errors before a query response become safe 502 responses; streaming failures use SSE error with no done.
code:
except Exception:
    raise HTTPException(502, FAILURE) from None
explanation: The query excerpt demonstrates the safe failure boundary. The stream function has its own catch yielding an error event after SSE begins; raw exception details are never returned.

title: Error + snackbar
text: Restore a readable error state and notification when the request fails.
explanation: Specific HTTP validation/origin errors survive the API client. Clipboard feedback also uses a visible notification. Timers and abort controllers are cleaned up.

title: Key: SSE error / input: 422
text: A missing key stops the stream before query() is called; invalid prompt bodies are rejected before SSE starts.
explanation: The corresponding query route returns 503. Pydantic rejects blank/oversized prompts with 422. None of these paths spends model credits.
